lines.t: I look around at this world You created,
At all the beautiful things I see,
And I know that you made it,
You made it all for me.
Oh, I thank You Lord for all You've done,
For everything under the sun,
‘Cause I know You made it all for love,
Every blessing from above.
All that I see, so I say...
Thank You Lord, every day.
Mountains high and oceans wide,
Every sunset, every tide,
Gentle breezes, skies so blue,
All remind me of Your truth.
In the beauty, I find peace,
Your creation never ceased,
In my heart, my love for You thrives,
Thank You Lord for making it all,
Thank You for the beauty you put in our lives.
Oh, I thank You Lord for all You've done,
For everything under the sun,
‘Cause I know You made it all for love,
Every blessing from above.
All that I see, so I say...
Thank You Lord, every day.
Oh, thank You Lord, for everything
For all that You made,
Every moment, every breath,
Your love speaks.
Thank You Lord, endlessly.
Oh thank you Lord.
